summary: UBS Group AG and UBS AG filed a Form 6-K containing their 31 March 2026 Pillar 3 Report, a routine regulatory capital and risk disclosure required under Basel III. The filing includes key metrics, risk-weighted assets, capital adequacy, leverage ratio, and liquidity funding for the group and its significant regulated subsidiaries. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender, activist campaign, restructuring, or capital return) is announced or implied. The filing is a standard periodic report by a foreign private issuer and carries no deal terms, recommendation, or event-driven catalyst. Nothing to watch or risk-arb angle exists.
